rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
P(A∪B) = P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B)
P(A∩B) = P(A)P(B|A)
P(A') = 1 − P(A)

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ treat "Random variable" as one blob → ✅ split into: random variable, its probability distribution.  ·  ❌ state the rule without its limit → ✅ note when it applies / stops applying.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: P(E) = favourable/total. Additive law: P(A∪B) = P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B). If mutually exclusive, P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B).  ·  Multiplicative: P(A∩B) = P(A)P(B|A); independence: P(A∩B) = P(A)P(B).
